hook.text: Tell the network what you want, not how. Intent-based networking turns goals into configs.

buildup.text: Say: 'video gets priority over email.' The system creates QoS rules across every device automatically.

discovery.text: The network verifies intent is being met. If conditions change, configs adapt automatically.

twist.text: Cisco DNA Center and Juniper Apstra lead IBN. They abstract complexity for network operators.

climax.text: Closed-loop automation: declare intent, deploy, verify, remediate. The network manages itself.

punchline.text: Say what you want, not how to build it. Networks that understand goals.

quiz.question: What does intent-based networking automate?
options: Translating business policies into network configurations automatically

details.summary: Intent-based networking lets administrators describe desired business outcomes instead of configuring individual devices.
details.whyItMatters: Intent-based networking bridges the gap between business requirements and network configuration. It reduces human error and ensures the network continuously delivers what the business needs.
takeaways: Administrators declare intent; the system handles configuration
Continuous verification ensures the network matches desired state
Automatic remediation fixes configuration drift without manual intervention

faq.question: How does intent-based networking work?
faq.answer: Administrators define business intent through a high-level interface. The IBN system translates intent into device configurations, pushes them to the network, monitors compliance in real time, and automatically corrects deviations. Machine learning helps optimize configurations and predict issues.

faq.question: Is intent-based networking practical today?
faq.answer: Cisco DNA Center and Juniper Apstra offer IBN capabilities. Full intent-based automation is still maturing, but elements like automated compliance checking and policy-driven configuration are production-ready. Most organizations adopt IBN gradually, starting with specific use cases.
